_source.describes: The hexcrawl Landmarks generator: FLAIL!'s five d20 axes.
_source.status: Unofficial. Not affiliated with Games Omnivorous.
_source.rationale: FLAIL!'s own Landmarks table, reproduced in face order, which the Third-Party Licence permits. A landmark is the thing you see from the next hex; a location is the thing you walk into. They share four axis names and nothing else — separate tables, separate field paths — because the book gives them different rows, and so either can be rewritten without disturbing a lock saved against the other. The Biome column repeats entries deliberately, exactly as the book prints it.
